name: Outer Appearance
overview: Scripture warns against placing trust in outward beauty or appearance, emphasizing that favor and physical attractiveness are fleeting and deceptive. True worth is found in fearing the Lord, as seen in Proverbs 31:30, rather than in external adornment or fine clothing highlighted in Luke 7:25. Believers are also cautioned to look beyond surface appearances, judging righteously rather than merely by what is seen, as John 7:24 instructs. Additionally, Matthew 7:15 illustrates the danger of false appearances, warning that those who seem harmless outwardly may conceal harmful intentions.
